description: Fast on-device speech-to-text keyboard and voice input - no cloud, no tracking. Parakeetype is a free and open-source speech-to-text app for Android. It works as a voice keyboard and as a speech recognition service for the whole system. All transcription happens entirely on your device using the Parakeet Ultra model (a further-trained version of NVIDIA's Parakeet-TDT v3) via ONNX Runtime - no audio ever leaves your phone, no account required, and the app has no internet access at all. Features • Speech-to-text keyboard: dictate into any text field • Speech-to-text input service: other apps such as translators, Firefox or Duolingo can use Parakeetype for their voice input • Very fast: the model is kept loaded in memory, so transcription starts right away • Fully on-device inference - completely private • Minimal permissions: no internet access required Based on Outspoke Parakeetype is a fork of the Outspoke app and adds new features on top of it. Requirements • Android 12 (API 31) or higher • ~630 MB free storage for the model file • The model is downloaded separately from the project's GitHub releases and imported in the app (CC-BY-4.0)
